question:
Alice, Bob, and Claire are on the same team in a soccer match. At the start of the match, they are each assigned to a position: Alice is playing right midfielder, Bob is playing left midfielder, and Claire is playing left winger.
As the game progresses, pairs of players occasionally swap positions. First, Bob and Alice trade positions. Then, Claire and Alice trade positions. Finally, Bob and Claire trade positions. At the end of the match, Alice is playing
Options:
(A) right midfielder
(B) left midfielder
(C) left winger
solution:
Positions are listed in player order: Alice, Bob, Claire.
Initial: (right midfielder, left midfielder, left winger)
1. Bob and Alice swap: (left midfielder, right midfielder, left winger)
2. Claire and Alice swap: (left winger, right midfielder, left midfielder)
3. Bob and Claire swap: (left winger, left midfielder, right midfielder)
Alice is the left winger, option (C).
Final answer: (C)
